description:
Official WHOOP Developer Platform v2 API. Provides programmatic access to a user's
cycles, sleep, recovery, workouts, and profile data. Authentication is OAuth 2.0
with PKCE; this spec also accepts a static bearer token via the WHOOP_ACCESS_TOKEN
environment variable for non-interactive contexts (CI, agents).

Pagination: every list endpoint enforces `limit <= 25` (default `10`). Use the
`nextToken` query parameter with the `next_token` value from the previous response.
Sort order is `start` descending. Time filters: `start`, `end` (ISO-8601 UTC).

tools.name: activity_get-sleep
tools.description: Get a single sleep by UUID. Required: sleepId. Returns the Sleep.

tools.name: activity_get-workout
tools.description: Get a single workout by UUID. Required: workoutId. Returns the Workout.

tools.name: activity_list-sleeps
tools.description: List sleep activities. Optional: limit (default: 10), start, end (plus 1 more). Returns the ActivityListSleepsResponse.

params.name: start
params.description: ISO-8601 UTC start of time window (defaults to 24h ago).

params.name: end
params.description: ISO-8601 UTC end of time window (defaults to now).

tools.name: activity_list-workouts
tools.description: List workouts. Optional: limit (default: 10), start, end (plus 1 more). Returns the ActivityListWorkoutsResponse.

params.name: start
params.description: ISO-8601 UTC start of time window (defaults to 24h ago).

params.name: end
params.description: ISO-8601 UTC end of time window (defaults to now).

tools.name: activity-mapping_get
tools.description: Translate a v1 sleep/workout id to a v2 UUID. Required: v1Id, type. Returns the ActivityMappingGetResponse.

tools.name: cycle_get
tools.description: Get a single cycle by id. Required: cycleId. Returns the Cycle.

tools.name: cycle_list
tools.description: Returns the user's cycles (a WHOOP day) ordered by start time descending. Optional: limit (default: 10), start, end (plus 1 more).

params.name: start
params.description: ISO-8601 UTC start of time window (defaults to 24h ago).

params.name: end
params.description: ISO-8601 UTC end of time window (defaults to now).

tools.name: cycle_recovery_get-for-cycle
tools.description: Get the recovery associated with a cycle. Required: cycleId. Returns the Recovery.

tools.name: cycle_sleep_get-for-cycle
tools.description: Get the sleep associated with a cycle. Required: cycleId. Returns the Sleep.

tools.name: recovery_list-recoveries
tools.description: List recovery records. Optional: limit (default: 10), start, end (plus 1 more). Returns the RecoveryListRecoveriesResponse.

params.name: start
params.description: ISO-8601 UTC start of time window (defaults to 24h ago).

params.name: end
params.description: ISO-8601 UTC end of time window (defaults to now).

tools.name: user_get-body-measurement
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's body measurements from WHOOP. No parameters. Returns the BodyMeasurement object with height_meter (float), weight_kilogram (float), and max_heart_rate (integer). Used by analytics commands that need physiological context; prefer 'whoami' if you also need profile info in one call.

tools.name: user_get-profile
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's basic WHOOP profile. No parameters. Returns the UserProfile object with user_id (int64), email, first_name, and last_name. Use this to confirm the active account or look up the user_id needed for cross-referencing other records; prefer 'whoami' if you also need body measurements in one call.

tools.name: user_revoke-oauth-access
tools.description: Revoke the user's OAuth access (delete token grants). Destructive.
